name: Die for Pay
storyline:
Die for Pay is a CO-OP Multiplayer action crime game about rising in an open world where nightly riots erupt and people kill without mercy. Take risks, make money through illegal means, gather your crew. When the siren sounds, curfew begins, and so does the carnage.

Day: Build Your Empire

You start with nothing but a small warehouse, an old pistol, and the last cash in your pocket.
Set up your machines, produce illegal goods, and sell them on the streets.
Buy contraband cheap from smugglers and sell it high on the market.
Track orders coming through your phone, meet with customers, expand your network.
Every dollar takes you one step higher.

Hire gangsters, grow your crew. Take control of your territory.
summary: Die for Pay is a CO-OP Multiplayer action crime game where you try to rise from nothing in a world where riots break out every night. Make money by day, gather your crew. By night, stand your ground with honor, or run. When the siren sounds, there's no mercy.
